title: Saudi Local Commerce Platform Development -- 2
description:

- Central Product Index: A unified cloud database containing numeric product codes, names (Arabic/English), images, categories, and barcodes, supporting bulk import and instant search, and connected across all apps and the admin panel to add and update products without duplication.
- Customer App: GPS location detection, browsing nearby stores, search by name or barcode, unified shopping cart, online payment and multiple payment options, live order tracking, and push notifications.
- Merchant App: Managing store profile, working hours, and coverage area, importing and managing products from the Central Product Index via barcode and updating prices and stock, receiving orders and assigning delivery, and sales reports.
- Standalone Delivery App: Receiving delivery tasks for the assigned entity, updating statuses, map navigation, and delivery confirmation via OTP.
- Field Supervision App: Logging store visits with location and time, submitting notes and photos, and adding/updating products in the Central Product Index via photography and barcode scanning.
- Web Admin Dashboard: Managing users, merchants, drivers, and supervisors, review and approval queue for new products added to the Central Product Index, managing fees and payouts, and reporting.
- Technical & Operational Standards: Full support for Arabic (RTL) and English, cloud hosting inside Saudi Arabia, and integration with payment gateways, maps, and messaging.

Contract & Ownership Terms:
- 100% ownership of the Source Code, databases, Central Product Index, and UI/UX designs in our favor.
- Registering developer accounts (Apple Developer and Google Play), hosting, and payment gateways exclusively under our company name.
- Strict confidentiality and no reuse of custom code or catalog data for any third party.
- Milestone-based payments tied to clear deliverables and acceptance testing, plus a free warranty period for bug fixes after launch.

Please include in your quote:
1. Total fixed cost and its breakdown across execution milestones.
2. Total duration in weeks for each milestone.
3. Proposed Tech Stack, delivery mechanism, warranty, and post-launch maintenance.

title: Website Order-Handling Claude Chatbot

Here is what I need from you:

• Front-end widget code that drops straight into my site (vanilla JS or React is fine) and hands the conversation off to Claude’s API. 
• Web-hook or middleware logic that translates user intent into the correct API call, then pushes the response back to the chat in plain language. 
• Clear setup notes so I can update intents, keys, or UI text without touching core code. 

Acceptance is simple: I should be able to open my staging site, ask “Where’s my order #1234?”, “Book me a table for four at 7 pm”, or “Cancel last week’s reservation”, and see the chatbot complete each request end-to-end without manual intervention. 

I am a Digital Communication graduate from CEU San Pablo University and have completed a master's degree in Big Data and Artificial Intelligence at the same institution. My professional profile stands at the intersection of creativity and logic. I combine the storytelling and strategic skills of a communicator with a solid technical background in programming, statistics, and data analysis. Throughout my professional career across diverse sectors, I have developed strong expertise in digital community management, content creation, and data-driven optimization. Beyond traditional digital marketing, I specialize in cutting-edge Generative AI production and AI-powered development. I build custom websites and interactive web applications using vibe coding workflows, and I design AI agents to automate processes and enhance digital strategies. Furthermore, I master a wide ecosystem of generative AI platforms and models—including Magnific AI, Higgsfield, and leading image, video, and voice synthesis tools—to produce high-impact visual assets and full-scale AI commercials. I do not just create content; I analyze its performance to apply a strategic approach that improves ROI and project outcomes. I thrive in multidisciplinary teams and am deeply motivated to continue growing in the field of Big Data and AI, contributing value through innovation, rigorous analysis, and creative problem-solving.

• Rekodkan setiap interaksi dalam Google Sheets atau Zendesk bagi tujuan penjejakan.

Keperluan asas

• Pengalaman atau minat dalam khidmat pelanggan—anda selesa berkomunikasi secara sopan dan profesional. 
• Akses Internet yang stabil dan peranti sendiri (telefon atau komputer).

• Kadar tindak balas ≤1 jam semasa syif. 
• Skor kepuasan pelanggan ≥90% (akan dinilai melalui borang ringkas). 
• Laporan ringkas dihantar pada penghujung setiap syif.

Sertakan ringkasan pengalaman berkaitan, alat yang pernah anda gunakan (contohnya Zendesk, Freshdesk, Intercom) dan jadual masa yang anda boleh komited. Saya menantikan kerjasama anda untuk memastikan setiap pelanggan berasa dihargai.

title: Live Multi City Inventory Dashboard
description:
I keep all warehouse inventory in a single Google Sheet and want that data to flow into a cloud-based dashboard that updates the moment the sheet changes. The goal is simple: everyone—from employees on the floor to management and resellers—should be able to see what is in stock without touching the spreadsheet.

The dashboard must display multiple-warehouse visibility, brand- and product-level views, SKU snapshots, and a combined total that can still be broken down to show ready stock in Delhi and Mumbai. Customers will log in to view only the quantities reserved for them, while staff and management enjoy broader access. Every report needs an “Export to Excel” button, and the entire interface has to be mobile-friendly for quick checks on phones.

I am open to the tool you prefer—Google Looker Studio, Power BI, Tableau, or a lightweight custom web app—provided it reads directly from the Google Sheet and refreshes instantly when I change a cell. Authentication can be Google sign-in or a simple role-based password system; whichever is fastest to manage.

Deliverables 
• Live dashboard URL with employee, reseller, customer, and management roles pre-configured 
• Automated sync script or connector tied to the Google Sheet (no manual refresh) 
• Excel download option on each report view 
• Short handover guide covering user management and basic layout edits 

Acceptance: during a quick screen-share I will edit a value in the Google Sheet and watch it update on all relevant dashboard tiles—including the combined total and individual Delhi/Mumbai figures—within seconds.

analysis.summary_ru: Облачный дашборд складских остатков, который читает данные из одной Google-таблицы и обновляется сразу после изменений. Нужны роли (сотрудники, реселлеры, клиенты, менеджмент), разбивка по Дели и Мумбаи, экспорт в Excel и мобильная версия.
analysis.reply:
You want warehouse stock from one Google Sheet to appear on a live dashboard for staff, resellers, customers and management, with per-city totals for Delhi and Mumbai, Excel export, and a phone-friendly layout. I'd build a lightweight custom web app rather than a BI tool, because per-customer reserved quantities and role-based views are easier to control that way. The sheet would connect through the Google Sheets API with a service account, and an Apps Script edit trigger would push changes to the backend so every tile refreshes within seconds. Login would use Google sign-in or role-based passwords, whichever you prefer. I estimate about 10–14 days for a working version, including the handover guide.

Live demos are in my portfolio: https://grachoffprod.github.io/portfolio/

Could you share the column layout of the sheet (warehouse, brand, SKU, reserved-for-customer)? And do you need Google sign-in, or are role-based passwords fine?

Вам нужно, чтобы остатки со склада из одной Google-таблицы появлялись на живом дашборде для сотрудников, реселлеров, клиентов и менеджмента, с итогами по Дели и Мумбаи, экспортом в Excel и удобной версией для телефона. description:

A complete project brief you can copy and paste into your freelancer job post follows below, along with practical tips for hiring and structuring milestones.

## Ready-to-Post Freelancer Project Brief

> **Project Title:** Multi-Track Online Coaching & Test Series Website (Olympiads, Class 6–10 Foundation, NEET & IIT JEE)
> **Overview:**
> I am looking for an experienced full-stack web developer or agency to build a responsive online coaching and test platform for four distinct academic verticals: **Olympiads**, **Basic Foundation (Classes 6–10)**, **NEET**, and **IIT JEE**. Each vertical must operate as a clearly separated learning track with its own courses, batches, schedules, study materials, and tests, while sharing a unified user account and payment system.
> **1. Four Separated Academic Verticals**
> * **Olympiads Track:** Subject/exam-wise batches and practice resources.
> * **Foundation Track (Classes 6–10):** Class-wise and subject-wise batches aligned with school fundamentals.
> * **NEET Track:** Physics, Chemistry, and Biology batches, test series, and revision modules.
> * **IIT JEE Track:** Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics batches (Main/Advanced structure), test series, and practice sets.
> * Students must be able to filter by vertical, class/target year, and batch, and only access content unlocked by their active enrollment.
> 
> 
> **2. Live Classes & Recorded Lectures**
> * **Live Lectures:** Batch-wise class schedule/timetable, join-class links or embedded live stream integration (e.g., Zoom/YouTube Live/Vimeo/WebRTC/streaming SDK), attendance or join tracking, and real-time or scheduled doubt support.
> * **Recorded Lectures:** Auto-archived or uploaded class recordings organized by vertical, batch, subject, and chapter, with playback speed controls, quality options, watch-progress tracking, and basic screen-recording/piracy deterrents (such as dynamic user watermarking and restricted direct downloads).
> 
> 
> **3. Notes & Study Material Access**
> * Chapter-wise PDF notes, class slides, DPPs (Daily Practice Problems), and assignments mapped to each batch.
> * In-browser PDF viewer with controlled download permissions (downloadable vs. view-only based on course settings).
> 
> 
> **4. Payment Gateway & Enrollment**
> * Checkout supporting UPI, cards, net banking, and wallets (e.g., Razorpay/Stripe/Cashfree as appropriate for your region), plus coupon/discount codes, course validity dates, automatic access activation upon successful payment, and downloadable/viewable payment receipts.
> 
> 
> **5. Student Dashboard**
> * Enrolled batches across verticals, upcoming live classes, recently watched recordings, bookmarked notes/questions, course expiry/validity status, profile settings, and overall progress summary.
> 
> 
> **6. Test Dashboard & Assessment Engine**
> * Support for full-length mocks, part/chapter tests, and practice tests with configurable timers, negative marking rules, question palettes (answered, unanswered, marked for review), auto-submit on timeout, and a post-test analytics report (score, accuracy, time per question, topic-wise strengths/weaknesses, and rank/percentile comparison where applicable).
> * Support for math and science notation (such as LaTeX/MathJax) and diagrams in questions and solutions.
> 
> 
> **7. Admin / Teacher Panel (Essential for Running the Site)**
> * Create and manage verticals, classes/batches, subjects, chapters, live class schedules, video/PDF uploads, pricing/coupons, test papers/question banks, and student enrollments/refunds.
> 
> 
> **8. Technical & Delivery Expectations**
> * Mobile-responsive design (since many students study on phones and tablets), clean UI/UX, role-based access control (Student, Teacher/Admin), deployment to live hosting/cloud, source code handover, and brief documentation/walkthrough.
> * Please include in your proposal: (a) recommended tech stack, (b) how you handle video hosting/security and test timers, (c) estimated timeline and cost broken down by milestones, and (d) links to relevant past work.

description:

4. **Intelligent Medical Coding** – AI-assisted ICD-10 diagnosis coding, sequencing, HCPCS review, and PDGM-related validation.
5. **Medicare Compliance & RCD Review** – Evaluate homebound status, skilled necessity, medical necessity, physician certification, and pre-claim review readiness.
6. **Recertification & Discharge Assistant** – Track certification periods, evaluate clinical documentation, and generate draft recertification justifications.
7. **Authorization Management** – Review payer requirements, prepare authorization packets, identify missing records, and draft appeal letters.
8. **Denial Prevention & Billing Readiness** – Cross-check orders, eligibility, documentation, and coding to identify potential claim denials.
9. **Clinical Documentation Improvement** – Identify inconsistencies, missing signatures, incorrect orders, and weak clinical documentation.
10. **AI Clinical Assistant** – Suggest patient-specific goals, interventions, patient education, and documentation improvements for clinician review.
11. **Scheduling & Field Operations** – Assist with clinician assignments, scheduling, route optimization, and travel-time planning.
12. **Analytics & Reporting Dashboard** – Display compliance scores, audit findings, patient status trends performance graphs downloadable reports.
13. **Document & Patient Management** – Secure PDF uploads document classification organized patient charts AI-powered document search.
14. **Security & Administration** – HIPAA-compliant architecture role-based access audit logs secure cloud storage data protection.

Additionally:
- We are particularly interested in developers who have built similar platforms before and can showcase their work or provide a demo of relevant past projects to demonstrate their expertise in this domain.

**Technical Requirements:**

- Integration with an existing advanced AI model through API.
- Ability to analyze multiple clinical documents together.

- Clean modern responsive interface scalable architecture for additional modules future EHR integration full ownership of source code database application.

title: AI Developer to Build a Connected AI Platform for SME's
description:
We're Lamp, an AI department for service businesses in Egypt. We're starting with SMEs (clinics, real estate brokerages, academies and finance-related services) and we have clients waiting. This is a real project, not a test. The full scope is in the attached document.

What we're building
One platform with the Executive Brain at the center, and modules that plug into it: Finance & Accounting, Reception, Sales, Marketing and People. Operations is designed per business. Nothing here works in isolation, and that's the point. Every module reads from and writes to one shared data layer, so they feed each other. Reception's conversations tell Marketing what customers actually ask. A closed deal in Sales triggers an invoice in Finance and a welcome message from Reception. Marketing knows which ad brought a paying customer, not just a click, and Finance turns that into the real cost per customer. That connection is the product.

The Executive Brain
The owner's branded app, installable on web and phone, and the hardest part of the build. Each module has its own chat, and a CEO chat queries all of them and returns one answer, in Egyptian Arabic or by voice note. Every number is calculated from real data, never generated by the model, and every answer cites its source. The dashboard shows a health score per department with drill-down from the whole company to a single customer, an Approval Center for one-tap approval of discounts, payments and budget changes, and an impact tracker against the client's baseline. Every module sends its notifications through the Brain, with priority levels, a daily cap and quiet hours.

The modules
Finance & Accounting is our flagship. It connects to the client's existing accounting software, drafts invoices automatically, submits e-invoices and e-receipts to the Egyptian Tax Authority, matches payments across InstaPay, wallets, cards and bank transfers, and produces live financial statements, a 13-week cash forecast and what-if scenarios. Reception answers WhatsApp, social DMs and calls 24/7, manages bookings with a waitlist, recovers missed calls and hands chats to staff with a summary. Sales contacts every lead within a minute or two, qualifies and scores them, runs follow-ups that stop when the lead replies, and keeps the CRM updated from calls and chats. Marketing builds the content calendar from real customer conversations and ties ad performance to actual revenue. title: Bespoke API-Powered Report Builder
description:
I am looking to develop a bespoke web-based application for my business that will allow me to create professional, customised reports by integrating data from multiple third-party websites and platforms via their APIs.

The application should have a flexible report-building interface, allowing me to design and customise my own report templates rather than relying on fixed, pre-designed formats.

Key functionality required:

API integrations: Ability to pull data automatically from several different third-party websites and platforms via their APIs and populate relevant sections of my reports.

Custom text fields: Ability to create editable text boxes throughout the report, allowing me to add my own commentary, descriptions and professional opinions.

Dropdown menus: Customisable dropdown fields with predefined options to ensure consistency and speed up report completion.

Photo uploads: Dedicated sections where users can upload photographs, arrange them within the report and add descriptions or captions.

Custom report templates: Ability to create, save and amend bespoke report templates, including different layouts and sections depending on the report type.

Dynamic content: The ability for information retrieved through APIs, dropdown selections and manual inputs to automatically populate the relevant sections of the report.

Report generation: Ability to generate a final, professionally formatted report, ideally in PDF format, with consistent branding, layouts, headers and footers.

User management: Ideally, multiple users should be able to log in, access the platform and create reports, with appropriate permissions.

The overall objective is to build a flexible, scalable reporting platform that combines automated data retrieval with manual input, allowing us to produce our own bespoke reports efficiently.

I am looking for a developer who can advise on the best technology and architecture for this project, assist with API integrations and deliver a fully functioning application with an intuitive, user-friendly interface.
